simpleoptserver.guide.page.1.title: Simple Opt Server
simpleoptserver.guide.page.1: Server optimizations: the view distance follows the server load within the server.properties bounds.
simpleoptserver.guide.page.2.title: View distance by server load
simpleoptserver.guide.page.2: On a dedicated server with players online, every stepSeconds (default 15) the average tick time is checked:
simpleoptserver.guide.page.3.title: View distance by server load
simpleoptserver.guide.page.3: above targetMspt (default 45 ms) the view distance drops by one down to minView (default 6), below 80 % of it the distance climbs back to the server.properties value.
simpleoptserver.guide.page.4.title: View distance by server load
simpleoptserver.guide.page.4: It never goes above server.properties or below 3. The simulation distance only moves with adjustSimulation (default false), because a smaller one changes farms and growth far away.
simpleoptserver.guide.page.5.title: View distance by server load
simpleoptserver.guide.page.5: With ServerCore installed this area stays off. /simpleoptserver status (game masters) shows every area and the current distances.
simpleoptserver.guide.page.6.title: Activation range (off by default)
simpleoptserver.guide.page.6: Changes gameplay, so it starts with mode off in config/simpleoptserver.json; set mode auto to use it (restart needed).
simpleoptserver.guide.page.7.title: Activation range (off by default)
simpleoptserver.guide.page.7: A mob with no living player within range blocks (default 32, 16 to 128) then runs its full tick only every interval-th tick (default 4, 2 to 20); its age counter keeps running.
simpleoptserver.guide.page.8.title: Activation range (off by default)
simpleoptserver.guide.page.8: Mobs stay fully active while they ride or carry others, are leashed, have a target, are hurt, airborne, in water or lava, burning, babies, in love or tamed; villagers, traders and bosses always stay active.
simpleoptserver.guide.page.9.title: Activation range (off by default)
simpleoptserver.guide.page.9: ServerCore covers the same area and wins; another mod hooking the same class switches it off too (target check).
simpleoptserver.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simpleoptserver.guide.page.10: /simpleoptserver config shows and changes every option of config/simpleoptserver.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleoptserver.guide.page.11.title: Commands
simpleoptserver.guide.page.11: The file is read once while the game starts, so a change is saved at once but takes effect after a restart (each answer says so). Permission level 2.
